context: Chord diagram showing asymmetric bilateral trade flows (billions USD) between 10 countries using a synthetic matrix
first_impression: Structurally honest chord layout with data-driven tick marks, but ribbon color assignment by source.index obscures trade directionality in the asymmetric matrix.
what_works: Tick marks are fully data-driven via groupTicks() using arc angle proportions, correctly scaling with data; d3.chord() handles the asymmetric matrix properly and ribbon widths at each arc end honestly encode directional flow volumes.
what_doesnt: Ribbon fill uses source.index color with no visual cue distinguishing which end is exporter vs importer, masking asymmetry that is the chart's core story; tick labels omit unit markers on the marks themselves (200, 400 with no '$B'), relying solely on the subtitle.
